input.text: In Regulation (EU) 2018/1139, Article 17 is replaced by the following text.

_note: A bare pinpoint with NO self-naming suffix of its own ('Article 17', no 'of this Regulation') sitting inside an UNQUOTED amending chapeau ('In <instrument>, ...') must be redirected EXTERNAL to the chapeau's own named instrument. Unlike xref-v2-m9-chapeau-ends-at-semicolon-explicit-self-overrides.json (which tests the explicit-self override INSTEAD of the chapeau), this vector genuinely exercises the chapeau redirect itself: disabling the chapeau-span construction turns 'Article 17' INTERNAL (wrong) instead of EXTERNAL.
